definitions.gloss: rice flour bread; bread made from rice flour
definitions.explanation: Bread made using rice flour instead of or in addition to wheat flour. Popular in Japan as a gluten-free alternative and as a way to promote domestic rice consumption.

examples.japanese: {米粉|こめこ}パン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もちもち→もちもち：05260_mochimochi⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Rice flour bread has a chewy, springy texture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{米粉|こめこ}パン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: I baked rice flour bread for a child with a wheat allergy.

examples.english: Rice flour bread has recently started appearing in school lunches, and versions using locally grown rice are popular.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{米粉|こめこ}→米粉：13771_komeko⟧ (rice flour) and ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧ (bread, from Portuguese "pão"). Part of a broader trend in Japan toward using domestically produced rice in non-traditional ways. Rice flour bread has a distinctive moist, chewy (⟦もちもち→もちもち：05260_mochimochi⟧) texture that differs from wheat bread.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {米粉|こめこ}パン⟦{専門店|せんもんてん}→専門店：15924_senmonten⟧: rice flour bread specialty shop
- {米粉|こめこ}パン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to bake rice flour bread
- ⟦グルテンフリー→グルテンフリー：23413_gurutenfurii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{米粉|こめこ}パン: gluten-free rice flour bread

CULTURAL NOTE:
The Japanese government has promoted ⟦{米粉|こめこ}→米粉：13771_komeko⟧ products since the 2000s as part of efforts to increase rice consumption, which has been declining as Japanese diets become more westernized. Many school lunch programs now include rice flour bread made from locally grown rice.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{食パン|しょくぱん}→食パン：14636_shokupan⟧: white bread / sandwich bread — the standard bread loaf in Japan
- ⟦{米粉|こめこ}→米粉：13771_komeko⟧: rice flour — the ingredient itself
